content.text: In the general discussion channel, a user posted a recruitment-style message advertising various paid roles including Beta Tester at $20/hour, Moderator at $350-400/week, Developer with negotiable rates for Rust, Python, or C++ skills, and Community Manager at $800/week, among others, asking interested parties to send a DM. Separately, a user shared a link to an X post and noted that elizaOS has very few updates on social media but believes the project is worth attention, also mentioning they discovered another project attempting to attract the elizaOS team's attention. Another user posted a lengthy proposal formatted as an AI evaluation request, pitching a nightlife and cultural event concept called Love Train Bronx targeting The Bronx, New York, framing it as an untapped web3 community market opportunity and requesting seed funding or a micro-grant. Odilitime briefly commented on a 0.x plugin appearing in 2026, suggesting some skepticism. General greetings and a shared X post link rounded out the channel activity.

In the coders channel, a developer introduced themselves as building paralens.ai, described as a structured transaction understanding engine for onchain activity. They asked what data sources or APIs agents currently use to understand wallets and transactions, and whether transaction-level intelligence or wallet-level behavioral datasets would be more valuable. Odilitime responded that elizaOS currently supports Helius, Birdeye, CoinMarketCap, CoinGecko, and more. The developer followed up asking whether those integrations are sufficient for understanding complex DeFi transactions or if there is custom logic on top for interpreting user actions and behaviors, to which Odilitime replied that there is probably always room for more. Additionally, a software engineer with a background in healthcare, finance, education, SaaS, and game development posted an introduction seeking collaborators for business expansion and long-term partnership, regardless of prior development experience.
